title: HandoffDocument
description: What one session leaves for the next when work crosses a session or agent boundary. The test of a complete handoff: a fresh agent resumes from this document plus the disk alone, without re-deriving anything and without believing an unverified claim. Backs rule X-handoff-document and eval E33. Shape taught in references/concurrency-and-handoffs.md; template in examples/handoff-document.md.

goal.description: The task in the user's words, not a paraphrase.

done.description: Work completed, one item per entry. An entry here with no matching verified entry is a claim, not a fact; list it under unverified instead.

command.description: The literal command or read that confirmed it.

verified.description: Evidence for the done items: command and output, never a paraphrase.

what.description: The item that is not done, or done but not verified.

why.description: The blocker, with the verbatim error when there is one.

unverified.description: What is not done or not verified, with the reason. Never empty when something was skipped.

in_progress.description: The one item mid-flight and its exact state (which file, which step, what is half-applied).

next.description: The next steps in order, concrete enough to start without re-planning. Up to three.

open_assumptions.description: Assumptions the work rests on that the user has not confirmed. See assumption-ledger.schema.json for the fuller shape.

decided_by.description: Rulings the agent made alone are the ones a resuming agent must be able to reopen.

decisions.description: Decisions and rulings taken during the work, with the reason, so the next session does not relitigate or silently reverse them.

owner.description: Who can answer it (the user, a named system, the next session).

files_touched.description: Every file this session created, edited, or deleted, by path. Must agree with the actual diff.

commands_to_resume.description: The first commands the next session runs, copy-pasteable: re-establish ground truth, then continue.

gotchas.description: Environment or tooling surprises the next session would otherwise rediscover.

load_first.description: Playbooks, skills, or reference files to load before resuming.

artifacts.description: Reference artifacts by path. Never restate their content here.

redacted.description: True once secrets and personal data have been removed from the document. A handoff is saved only after this pass.

written_at.description: Timestamp from the harness or the project's date authority, ISO 8601.
